prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-05-01, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2026-05-01):
| Current ratio           | 1.53 |
| Retained earnings       | 60,632M |
| Current liabilities     | 14,621M |
| Current assets          | 22,316M |
| Shareholders' equity    | 51,940M |
| Total liabilities       | 61,341M |
| Total assets            | 113,281M |
| EBIT / operating income | 1,863M |
| Revenue                 | 11,005M |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The company shows solid asset base and equity (Total assets 113.3B, Shareholders’ equity 52.0B, Retained earnings 60.6B) with a healthy albeit moderate leverage (Total liabilities 61.3B, liabilities/assets ~0.54) and respectable EBIT margin on revenue (EBIT 1.86B on 11.01B revenue). Liquidity is acceptable with a current ratio of 1.53, though not exceptionally strong, indicating reasonable ability to meet near-term obligations. Taken together, these factors suggest a solid investment-grade profile with some risk sensitivity, consistent with a BBB+ rating.

DECISION: BBB+
